item: Row 372(b): the 27 app-map.js renderers the frozen-renderer scan listed follow a live language switch
summary: Status lines, message lines and transient button labels in app-map.js (map coverage, OSM lane line, OSM regions, dump reader and full-text search, statistics directory/ingest/fetch, series corpus, Wikipedia tracking and history, folder picker) now draw through ooLive/ooLiveHtml, so a language switch redraws them from what they hold with no request; server and user values stay escaped. Surfaces holding controls, listeners or a map (the dump table, the OSM region list, the OSM profile and geography panels, the dump index status and its pickers) are redrawn from their last reading by app-map.js's own oo:langchange listener. dumpFtsClear empties its output with replaceChildren(). The 27 lines leave configs/i18n_frozen_renderers.txt; a node suite drives four of the renderers through en->fr and fails on the old code. A language switch during an in-flight OSM start does not redraw the region list (which would re-enable its button).
